metadata.question: Was the water extent around the location (11.184384, 35.114837) greater on February 14, 2022 than on February 6, 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Point(11.184384, 35.114837) buffered to 2 km.
- Dates: Compare around 2019-02-06 and 2022-02-14 using ±7 days; if empty, expand to ±21 days.
- Collections: Primary Sentinel-2 SR (S2_SR_HARMONIZED). Fallback to Landsat L2 (L8/L9 combined).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds/shadows/snow using S2 SCL classes (exclude 0,1,3,8,9,10,11).
- For Landsat L2, mask QA_PIXEL bits: dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, cloud shadow, snow.
- Compute MNDWI and classify water as MNDWI > 0.2.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after fallback and expanded window: C1.
- If after masking valid pixel count is 0: C2.
- If reduceRegion returns null/NaN: C3.
- Otherwise compare water fraction (waterCount/validCount) for 2022 vs 2019. Strict greater => A, else B.

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Parameters
    const lon = 11.184384, lat = 35.114837;
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer(2000);
    const scale = 1000; // per requirement
    const maxPixels = 1e9;

    const totalCount = ee.Image(1).rename('c').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('c');

    const totalCountVal = totalCount.getInfo();
    if (totalCountVal === null || totalCountVal === 0) {
      console.log('Total pixel count invalid.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    function s2Mask(img) {
      const scl = img.select('SCL');
      const ok = scl.neq(0).and(scl.neq(1)).and(scl.neq(3))
        .and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)).and(scl.neq(11));
      return img.updateMask(ok);
    }

    function landsatMask(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // dilated cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))      // cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))      // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))      // cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));     // snow
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }

    function mndwiFromS2(img) {
      const green = img.select('B3');
      const swir1 = img.select('B11');
      const mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('mndwi');
      return mndwi.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    }

    function mndwiFromLandsat(img) {
      const green = img.select('SR_B3').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      const swir1 = img.select('SR_B6').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      const mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('mndwi');
      return mndwi.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    }

    function getS2Col(centerDate, winDays) {
      const start = ee.Date(centerDate).advance(-winDays, 'day');
      const end = ee.Date(centerDate).advance(winDays + 1, 'day');
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 90))
        .map(s2Mask);
    }

    function getLandsatCol(centerDate, winDays) {
      const start = ee.Date(centerDate).advance(-winDays, 'day');
      const end = ee.Date(centerDate).advance(winDays + 1, 'day');
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end).map(landsatMask);
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end).map(landsatMask);
      return l8.merge(l9);
    }

    function reduceWaterStats(mndwiImg) {
      const water = mndwiImg.gt(0.2).rename('water').updateMask(mndwiImg.mask());
      const validCount = mndwiImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('mndwi');
      const waterCount = water.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('water');
      return ee.Dictionary({valid: validCount, water: waterCount});
    }

    function pickBest(col, sortProp) {
      // Sort ascending by cloud property; if missing, sorting is no-op
      return ee.Image(col.sort(sortProp, true).first());
    }

    function fmtPct(x) {
      return (x * 100).toFixed(1);
    }

    async function analyzeOne(targetDate, label) {
      // Try Sentinel-2 ±7
      let s2 = getS2Col(targetDate, 7);
      let s2size = s2.size().getInfo();
      let used = null, usedSrc = null, triedExpanded = false;

      if (s2size === 0) {
        // Expand to ±21
        s2 = getS2Col(targetDate, 21);
        s2size = s2.size().getInfo();
        triedExpanded = true;
      }

      if (s2size > 0) {
        const s2img = pickBest(s2, 'CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE');
        const mndwi = mndwiFromS2(s2img);
        const stats = reduceWaterStats(mndwi);
        const out = stats.getInfo();
        if (out.valid === null) return {status: 'C3'};
        if (out.valid === 0) {
          // Fallback to Landsat
        } else {
          const dateStr = ee.Date(s2img.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo();
          const valid = out.valid;
          const water = out.water || 0;
          const waterPct = valid > 0 ? (water / valid) : 0;
          const cloudPct = (totalCountVal - valid) / totalCountVal;
          console.log(`${label} S2 imgs: ${s2size}${triedExpanded ? ' (±21d)' : ''}; chosen: ${dateStr}`);
          console.log(`${label} Valid: ${valid}, Water: ${water} (${fmtPct(waterPct)}%), Cloud: ${fmtPct(cloudPct)}%`);
          return {status: 'ok', source: 'S2', date: dateStr, valid, water, waterPct, cloudPct};
        }
      } else {
        // No S2; proceed to Landsat
      }

      // Landsat fallback
      let ls = getLandsatCol(targetDate, 7);
      let lssize = ls.size().getInfo();
      let expandedLS = false;
      if (lssize === 0) {
        ls = getLandsatCol(targetDate, 21);
        lssize = ls.size().getInfo();
        expandedLS = true;
      }
      if (lssize === 0) {
        return {status: 'C1'};
      }
      const lsImgRaw = pickBest(ls, 'CLOUD_COVER');
      const isL9 = ee.String(lsImgRaw.get('SPACECRAFT_ID')).compareTo('LANDSAT_9').eq(0); // just for info
      const mndwiLS = mndwiFromLandsat(lsImgRaw);
      const lsStats = reduceWaterStats(mndwiLS).getInfo();
      if (lsStats.valid === null) return {status: 'C3'};
      if (lsStats.valid === 0) return {status: 'C2'};
      const lsDate = ee.Date(lsImgRaw.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo();
      const valid = lsStats.valid;
      const water = lsStats.water || 0;
      const waterPct = valid > 0 ? (water / valid) : 0;
      const cloudPct = (totalCountVal - valid) / totalCountVal;
      console.log(`${label} LS imgs: ${lssize}${expandedLS ? ' (±21d)' : ''}; chosen: ${lsDate}`);
      console.log(`${label} Valid: ${valid}, Water: ${water} (${fmtPct(waterPct)}%), Cloud: ${fmtPct(cloudPct)}%`);
      return {status: 'ok', source: 'Landsat', date: lsDate, valid, water, waterPct, cloudPct};
    }

    console.log(`Geom buffer: 2000 m, scale: ${scale} m, total px: ${totalCountVal}`);

    const res2019 = await analyzeOne('2019-02-06', '2019');
    if (res2019.status !== 'ok') {
      console.log(res2019.status);
      return;
    }
    const res2022 = await analyzeOne('2022-02-14', '2022');
    if (res2022.status !== 'ok') {
      console.log(res2022.status);
      return;
    }

    const delta = res2022.waterPct - res2019.waterPct;
    console.log(`Δ water% (2022-2019): ${(delta * 100).toFixed(1)}%`);

    if (!isFinite(delta)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (delta > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
